# form.addStick

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.3</span></div>

Add a stick widget.

```lua
form.addStick(line, rect, xIndex, yIndex)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the widget should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `xIndex` | number | yes | the horizontal analog index |
| `yIndex` | number | yes | the vertical analog index |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addStick(nil, {x=0, y=0}, 0, 1)
```
